title: Not Your Typical Cucumber Salad
description: Truth be told I don’t like traditional cucumber salad. Too much vinegar in my opinion. This salad is Mayo based and I always kick myself for not doubling the recipe.

ingredients.text: 8 mini Israeli pickles (You can also use dill or gherkins. If the pickles are large use approximately 5)

steps: Mix all dressing ingredients together before mixing over the vegetables.
clipping_notes: This salad should last almost a week in the fridge.
Feel free to make it your own by adding in radishes or chick peas or whatever you’re in the mood of. No rules ! Enjoy 😉
Make this a @healthyonthebeach approved recipe by using monk fruit instead of sugar and using a homemade Mayo like @fullnfree creamy dressing.
